Verified in-session: GLB inventory (13 meshes, 2 cornea nodes, eye material only on globe mesh 10) + iris-region UV means at x=+-30.7mm + violet debug-viz red disc covering the iris.
method.envChange: sclera-only envMap attenuation via onBeforeCompile in eye-shader/eye-sclera-shade.ts (NEW): iblIrradiance+radiance x 0.35 outside the iris disc (EYE_SCLERA_RADIUS_UV 135/1024, feather 8/1024), iris disc keeps envMapIntensity 1.0. Injection point measured in three r184 sources (lights_fragment_maps; the envmap_fragment chunk is a PMREM no-op — first try hooked there and measured POST==PRE to +-2 levels). Iris-centre numerals are the mesh-derived eye-parallax centres (re-measured on the embedded eye texture dark pupils, both GLBs embed the identical 594900-byte texture).
method.whyLidContact: first try was a key shadow map (map 2048 over +-0.3m = 0.29mm texels, head-recentered axis, bias -0.0001/normalBias 0.001, near 0.5/far 2.6): the shadow-only ablation moved M2b by -0.05 (noise floor 0.156) — the conformed lids sit ~0-1mm off the globe AND the upper sclera meets the overhead key at grazing incidence, so no shadow map resolves the occlusion. The contact term darkens sclera texels within 7mm below the live upper-lid margin plane (uLidDarken 0.85, smoothstep falloff): the margin is recomputed from SKINNED lid-vertex positions every render (bind~=live assumption exposed by measurement: matrixWorld-only search landed on bind-pose garbage at centre height; the skeleton.accumulate path finds the margin at +3.2mm aisha / +1.5mm body2 over the pupil, 217/226 column verts), follows the lid under pose/gaze (world-space margin transformed into the globe's current object space each render, never baked to globe UV), masked to sclera texels by (1-irisM) (iris-sparing), no skin mesh touched (skin crops bit-identical).
method.acesGuard: isolated-subject-lab.ts refuses (throws) when eyeRuntimeShading resolves ON and renderer.toneMapping !== ACESFilmicToneMapping. eyeRuntimeShading defaults ON only for portrait+product-rig; explicit false renders the legacy eye (PRE). Probe: toneMapping=None + shading -> refusal 'eyeRuntimeShading requires ACESFilmic tone mapping (got 0)'; same + eyeRuntimeShading:false -> renders (guard scoped).

sweep.method: one-constant-at-a-time around the shipped point (atten 0.35 / band 0.007 / darken 0.85 = POST row), both subjects FRONT, PRE-ID masks, RoomEnvironment portrait rig; per row M1/M2b/D90 + catch-light max-box. 12 sweep renders + shipped POST row.
sweep.reading: atten: M1 moves monotonically toward goal as atten falls (aisha -14.22/-13.18/-11.73; body2 -14.21/-13.06/-11.50); M2b flat (-4.8..-5.1 / -2.4..-3.1) so atten does not drive the gradient. 0.25 lands aisha M1 nearest goal but deepens the documented CL deviation (88.6 vs 90.6) and iris-ring dimming with no gate need; all three pass G1/G2. Keep 0.35 (balances M1 progress with constancy headroom). band: 7mm is the M2b optimum on both (aisha -3.76/-4.88/-3.50; body2 -2.55/-2.74/-0.88 — 10mm collapses the gradient by reaching the lower strip and overshoots aisha M1 past goal). Keep 0.007. darken: 0.7 FAILS G1 on body2-front (M2b -0.257, need below -0.633) — ruled out; 1.0 passes but overshoots toward harshness (M2b -7.38/-5.91, deeper CL deviation) with no gate need; the accepted sheet is 0.85. Keep 0.85. No value changes; no re-render; no sheet redo.
